identity_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; sorted object keys; ordered arrays; no NaN; SHA256; schema_version=1
source_set_identity: sorted unique registered parent document SHA256; aliases outside content identity
recipe_identity: all declared generation conditions, exact model-visible legacy metadata and taxonomy bytes
repeat_policy: new unique generator run; never reuse a cache as an independent repetition
legacy_context: case_id,condition_id,lab_run_id,input_manifest are retained verbatim; new legacy run usually changes recipe_id
snapshot_policy: only completed verified official real generations; full canonical package hashes; explicit immutable snapshot selection
task_binding: exact nonempty allowed parent SourceSet plus exact expected recipe/condition/classification/scope
generation_authorization: existing ExperimentRunner execution gate and credential/budget checks
downstream_authorization: existing per-experiment grants and immutable budget ledger
